warning a11y_click_events_have_key_events 9:1-9:52 Visible, non-interactive element `<div>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events
warning a11y_no_static_element_interactions 9:1-9:52 `<div>` with a click handler must have an ARIA role
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions
warning event_directive_deprecated 9:28-9:45 Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
    https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
warning non_reactive_update 2:6-2:8 `bg` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
    https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
